text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed bumps in Charley Roach Lane, between Arlington Avenue and Rushton Road.

The Toronto and East York Community Council : 1. Authorized the installation of speed bumps in Charley Roach Lane, between Arlington Avenue and Rushton Road, at the locations shown on Drawing 421G-3471 attached to the report dated January 13, 2020 from the Acting Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
